words.ex: They explore the forest to find hidden caves.
words.ex_cn: 他们探索森林以寻找隐藏的洞穴。
words.en: To explore means to travel over or through an unfamiliar area in order to learn about it or to search for something valuable.

words.ex: The survival of the animals depends on the weather.
words.ex_cn: 这些动物的生存取决于天气。
words.en: The state or fact of continuing to live or exist, typically in spite of an accident, ordeal, or difficult circumstances.

words.tr: phrase. 紧随…之后；紧接着；在…之后不久
words.ex: On the heels of the economic crisis came a wave of social unrest.
words.ex_cn: 经济危机之后，紧接着就出现了一波社会动荡。
words.en: Immediately following something, especially an event or occurrence.

words.ex: The teacher showed a specimen of a butterfly.
words.ex_cn: 老师展示了一个蝴蝶标本。
words.en: A specimen is a single thing or example of something, especially one that is used to represent the whole group or type.

words.ex: This forest has many different species of birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有多种不同的鸟类物种。
words.en: A species is a class of plants or animals whose members have the same main characteristics and are able to breed with each other.

words.ex: I assume it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我假定明天会下雨。
words.en: If you assume that something is true, you accept that it is true without proof.

words.ex: He started the puzzle from the beginning.
words.ex_cn: 他从头开始做这个拼图。
words.en: From the very start; at the first stage of something.

words.tr:
n. 影响（力）；
v. 影响；
words.ex: The teacher had a big influence on her students.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生们有很大的影响。
words.en: The power to affect, control, or manipulate someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 迄今为止；到那时为止
words.ex: He has not finished his homework as yet.
words.ex_cn: 他还没有完成作业。
words.en: Up to the present time; until now.

words.tr: adj. 灭绝的；熄灭的；绝种的；
words.ex: The dodo is an extinct bird.
words.ex_cn: 渡渡鸟是一种灭绝的鸟。
words.en: If a species of animals or plants is extinct, it no longer has any living members, either in the world or in a particular place.

words.tr:
adj. 巨大的；伟大的；
n. 巨人；伟人；
words.ex: The giant elephant stood near the tree.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的大象站在树旁。
words.en: A giant is an imaginary person who is very big and strong, especially one mentioned in old stories. In everyday language, a giant can also refer to a very large and successful company or organization.

words.ex: The boy caught a squid at the beach.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在海滩上抓到一只鱿鱼。
words.en: A squid is a sea creature with a long soft body and many tentacles around its mouth.

words.ex: The scientist observe the birds every morning.
words.ex_cn: 科学家每天早上观察鸟类。
words.en: If you observe a person or thing, you watch them carefully, especially in order to learn something about them.

words.tr: n. 观察；观测；注意；监视；(观察后的）意见；
words.ex: The scientist made an observation about the bird's behavior.
words.ex_cn: 科学家对这只鸟的行为进行了观察。
words.en: The act of noticing or watching something carefully in order to gain information.

words.tr: adj. 难以捉摸的；不易被抓获（觉察、理解或记忆）的；
words.ex: The truth remained elusive.
words.ex_cn: 真相难以捉摸。
words.en: Difficult to find, catch, or achieve; difficult to remember or understand.

words.tr: n. 栖息地；居留地；产地；
words.ex: The panda's habitat is in the mountains of China.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫的栖息地在中国的山区。
words.en: The natural environment in which a species or group of species lives.

words.ex: He smiled for the first time today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天第一次笑了。
words.en: If something happens for the first time, it has never happened before.

words.ex: The invention of the wheel was a landmark in human history.
words.ex_cn: 轮子的发明是人类历史上的一个里程碑。
words.en: A landmark is a building or feature of a landscape that is easily seen and recognized from a distance, especially one that enables someone to establish their location.

words.ex: His ingenuity solved the problem with a simple tool.
words.ex_cn: 他的独创力用一个简单的工具解决了问题。
words.en: Ingenuity is the ability to think of clever and original ways to solve problems.

words.ex: The project was a monumental task.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目是一项巨大的任务。
words.en: If you describe something as monumental, you are emphasizing that it is very large and impressive, or that it is of great importance or significance.

words.tr: 短语. 沧海一粟；微不足道的一小部分
words.ex: His donation was just a drop in the bucket compared to what the project needs.
words.ex_cn: 他的捐款相比项目所需只是九牛一毛。
words.en: A very small or insignificant amount, especially in comparison to what is needed or expected.

words.tr: phrase. 在海洋中；在大海里
words.ex: The fish swim in the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在海洋里游动。
words.en: Situated or occurring within the sea; a vast, open body of water.

words.ex: Water is vital for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you say that something is vital, you mean that it is necessary or very important.

words.tr: phrase. 为…提供生活所需；供养；为…做准备；考虑到
words.ex: He works hard to provide for his family.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作来养家。
words.en: To supply what is needed for someone or something; to make preparations for something; to support or sustain someone financially.

words.tr:
n. 影响力；冲击（力）；
v. 对…产生影响；
words.ex: The new law had a big impact on education.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律对教育产生了重大影响。
words.en: The effect or influence of one person, thing, or action, on another.

words.ex: The planet Mars is red.
words.ex_cn: 火星是红色的。
words.en: A planet is a large object in space that moves around a star, such as the sun, and does not produce its own light.

words.ex: We learn about animals in science class.
words.ex_cn: 我们在科学课上了解动物。
words.en: To gain knowledge or information about a particular subject or topic.

words.ex: He read the book in its entirety.
words.ex_cn: 他从头到尾读了这本书。
words.en: The whole of something, especially when considered as a single unit.

words.tr: phrase. 完整地；全部地；作为一个整体地
words.ex: The book must be read in its entirety to understand the story.
words.ex_cn: 这本书必须从头到尾完整阅读才能理解故事。
words.en: Completely; as a whole, without leaving out any part.

words.ex: The fishing vessel sailed out at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 那艘渔船在黎明时出海。
words.en: A vessel is a large boat or a container for holding liquids.

words.tr:
n. 纪录片；
adj. 文书的；
words.ex: We watched a documentary about pandas last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚看了一部关于熊猫的纪录片。
words.en: A documentary is a film or television or radio programme that gives factual information about a particular subject.

words.tr:
n. 外星人；外国人；外侨；
adj. 外国的；陌生的；相异的；
words.ex: The boy saw an alien in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在森林里看到了一个外星人。
words.en: An alien is someone who is not a citizen of the country in which they live, or a creature from outer space.

words.ex: A shark swam near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 一条鲨鱼在海滩附近游动。
words.en: A shark is a large fish that lives in the sea and has very sharp teeth.

words.ex: The whale swims deep in the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 鲸在海洋深处游动。
words.en: A whale is a very large mammal that lives in the sea.

words.tr: phrase. 因某事（病以外）而死
words.ex: He died from a car accident.
words.ex_cn: 他因车祸去世。
words.en: If someone dies from a particular cause, that cause is the reason for their death.

words.ex: Many people die of cold in winter.
words.ex_cn: 许多人在冬天死于寒冷。
words.en: To die of something means to die because of a particular cause, such as an illness or an accident.

words.tr: phrase. 洗餐具；洗脸和手；将...冲上岸；结束；毁掉
words.ex: He washes up after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他饭后洗碗。
words.en: To clean the dishes, cutlery, and other utensils used in preparing and eating a meal; to clean one's hands and face.

words.tr: n. 潜水器，深潜器，潜艇 adj. 能潜入[可浸入]水中的
words.ex: The submersible was designed for deep-sea exploration.
words.ex_cn: 这艘潜水器是为深海探索而设计的。
words.en: A submersible is a small vehicle that is designed to operate underwater, especially for exploring or working in deep water.

words.tr: adj. 随后的；后来的；接踵而至的； v. “ensue”的现在分词；
words.ex: The ensuing meeting was canceled.
words.ex_cn: 随后的会议被取消了。
words.en: Following immediately after something else.

words.tr:
n. 狂乱；狂暴；狂怒
v. 使狂乱；使狂怒
words.ex: The crowd went into a frenzy when the singer appeared.
words.ex_cn: 当歌手出现时，人群陷入了狂热。
words.en: A frenzy is a state of uncontrolled excitement or wild behavior.

words.ex: There was an array of people at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会上人山人海。
words.en: An array of different things or people is a large number or wide range of them.

words.ex: He overlooked the mistake in the report.
words.ex_cn: 他忽略了报告中的错误。
words.en: If you overlook a fact or problem, you do not notice it, or do not realize how important it is.

words.tr: n. 微生态系统；小规模生态系统
words.ex: A small pond forms a micro-ecosystem with fish, plants, and bugs.
words.ex_cn: 一个小池塘形成了一个由鱼、植物和昆虫组成的微型生态系统。
words.en: A micro-ecosystem is a small, self-contained ecological system that is a miniature version of a larger ecosystem.

words.ex: Wolves feed on deer in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 狼在森林里以鹿为食。
words.en: To consume something as food or to derive nourishment from it.

words.ex: We had dinner at a buffet with many dishes to choose from.
words.ex_cn: 我们在自助餐吃了晚饭，有很多菜可以选。
words.en: A buffet is a meal consisting of several dishes from which guests serve themselves. As a verb, to buffet means to strike repeatedly and violently.

words.tr:
adj. 古老的；
n. 古董；
words.ex: He bought an antique chair from the old market.
words.ex_cn: 他从旧市场买了一把古老的椅子。
words.en: Something that is antique is old and often valuable because it is rare or well made.

words.tr:
v. 给…打钩；发出滴嗒声；
n. 钩号；
words.ex: Please tick the box if you agree.
words.ex_cn: 如果你同意，请在方框里打钩。
words.en: The word 'tick' can refer to the sound a clock makes, a very short period of time, a mark used to indicate something, or a type of small insect. As a verb, it can mean to make a ticking sound or to mark something with a tick.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 稍微打开；撬开；破开
words.ex: He cracks open the door to see who is outside.
words.ex_cn: 他把门打开一条缝，看看外面是谁。
words.en: To open something with a cracking sound, often implying that it is done with some force or effort.

words.ex: The lock has an intricate design.
words.ex_cn: 这个锁有复杂的结构。
words.en: You use intricate to describe something that has many small parts or details.

words.ex: He shifted the gear to slow down the car.
words.ex_cn: 他换挡以减慢车速。
words.en: Gear refers to a toothed wheel that works with others to alter the relation between the speed of a driving mechanism (such as the engine of a vehicle) and the speed of the driven parts (the wheels). It can also mean equipment that is used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The hostile neighbor shouted at us every morning.
words.ex_cn: 那个敌意的邻居每天早上都对我们大喊大叫。
words.en: If you are hostile to another person or an idea, you disagree with them or disapprove of them, often showing this in your behavior.

words.tr: n. 专门知识；专门技能；
words.ex: His expertise in computers helps the team solve problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在计算机方面的专门知识帮助团队解决问题。
words.en: Expertise is special skill or knowledge that is acquired by training, study, or practice.

words.ex: The similarity between the two paintings is clear.
words.ex_cn: 这两幅画的相似点很明显。
words.en: The quality or state of being similar; likeness or resemblance.

words.ex: There is a disparity in pay between men and women.
words.ex_cn: 男女之间的工资存在差异。
words.en: A disparity between two or more things is a noticeable difference between them.

words.tr:
n. 数量；数额；
v. 总计；等于；
words.ex: The amount of water in the bottle is small.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里的水量很少。
words.en: An amount of something is how much there is of it, or how much you have, need, or get.

words.tr: n. 资金；款项；拨款； v. “fund”的现在分词；
words.ex: The school needs more funding for new books.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校需要更多资金来购买新书。
words.en: Funding is money which is used to pay for a particular activity or to help achieve a particular purpose.

words.tr: adj. 无数的；多的；数不清的；
words.ex: There are countless stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中有无数颗星星。
words.en: Too numerous to count.

words.tr: 介词短语。在…的表面之下；暗中；不显露地
words.ex: The fish swim under the surface of the lake.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在湖面下游泳。
words.en: Beneath the outer layer or top of something; not immediately visible or obvious.

words.tr: phrase. 在表面之下；指事物隐藏的、未显露的部分
words.ex: The fish swim below the surface.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在水面下游泳。
words.en: Underneath the outer layer or exterior; not immediately apparent.

words.tr: phrase. 在表面之下；在事物表象背后（指隐藏的、未显露的内容或情感）
words.ex: The water looks calm, but there are dangers beneath the surface.
words.ex_cn: 水面看起来平静，但水面下有危险。
words.en: Below the surface; in a position that is not immediately apparent or visible.

words.tr: phrase. （使）组合在一起，（使）吻合，协调搭配
words.ex: The puzzle pieces fit together easily.
words.ex_cn: 这些拼图块很容易拼合在一起。
words.en: To fit together means to combine or arrange parts or elements in a way that they form a coherent or functional whole.

words.ex: He used a jigsaw to cut the wooden board.
words.ex_cn: 他用竖锯切割木板。
words.en: A jigsaw is a machine with a fine blade used for cutting shapes in wood or metal. It is also a puzzle consisting of a picture printed on cardboard or wood and cut into various pieces of different shapes that have to be fitted together.

words.ex: He solved the crossword puzzle quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解开了这个填字谜。
words.en: If something puzzles you, you do not understand it and feel confused.

words.ex: The completion of the project took three months.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的完成花了三个月。
words.en: The act of finishing or making something whole or perfect.

words.ex: The letter revealed his secret.
words.ex_cn: 这封信揭露了他的秘密。
words.en: To reveal something means to make known something that was previously secret or unknown.

words.ex: The new shelf does not fit into the corner.
words.ex_cn: 这个新架子放不进角落里。
words.en: If you fit into a group or situation, you seem to belong there because you are similar to the other people involved.

words.tr: phrase. 为了某人的利益；为了帮助某人
words.ex: He worked hard for his sister's benefit.
words.ex_cn: 他为他妹妹的利益努力工作。
words.en: For the advantage or good of someone.

words.tr: phrase. 为了某人的利益；为使某人受益
words.ex: He worked hard for the benefit of his family.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作是为了家人的利益。
words.en: If something is done for the benefit of someone, it is done in order to help them or be useful to them.

words.tr:
adj. 极重要的；
n. 紧急的事；
words.ex: It is imperative to drink water every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天喝水非常重要。
words.en: If it is imperative that something is done, that thing is extremely important and must be done.

words.ex: The two countries signed an accord to stop the war.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了一项协议以停止战争。
words.en: An accord is an official agreement or treaty. It can also refer to a state of agreement or harmony.

words.ex: The team went on an expedition to the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这支队伍去山上探险了。
words.en: An expedition is an organized journey that is made for a particular purpose such as exploration.

words.tr: phrase. 缩减（活动、范围、数量等的等级）
words.ex: The company will scale back its production this year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司今年将缩减生产。
words.en: If you scale back something, you make it smaller in size, amount, or extent than it used to be.

words.tr: adj. 地球外的；地外的；外星球的；
words.ex: The movie shows an extraterrestrial life form.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了一种地球外的生命形式。
words.en: An extraterrestrial is a creature that comes from or exists outside the planet Earth.

words.ex: He made a permanent change to his lifestyle.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的生活方式做出了永久的改变。
words.en: Something that is permanent exists or happens all the time, or exists for a long time without changing.

words.ex: The new phone is too costly for me.
words.ex_cn: 这部新手机对我来说太贵了。
words.en: If you say that something is costly, you mean that it costs a lot of money, often more than you would want to pay.

words.tr: n. 大型项目；特大项目
words.ex: The city is building a mega-project to fix the roads.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市正在建设一个大型项目来修复道路。
words.en: A very large and important project, especially one that involves a lot of planning and money.

words.ex: The problem arises from a simple mistake.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题源于一个简单的错误。
words.en: If a situation or problem arises from a particular event or activity, it is caused by it.

words.tr: phrase. 决心要做某事；一心想做某事
words.ex: He is set on becoming a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他决心要当一名医生。
words.en: To be determined to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 抬高；迫使...上升；驱车来到
words.ex: The shortage of apples will drive up the price.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的短缺会抬高价格。
words.en: To cause something to increase in amount or level, especially prices or costs.

words.ex: The sun gives off radiation.
words.ex_cn: 太阳发出辐射。
words.en: Radiation is energy that comes from a source and travels through space at the speed of light. This energy has an electric field and a magnetic field associated with it, and has wave-like properties. You could also call radiation 'electromagnetic waves'.

words.ex: The miniaturization of phones makes them easier to carry.
words.ex_cn: 手机的小型化使它们更容易携带。
words.en: The process of making something much smaller than its original size, especially in the context of technology and electronics.

words.ex: He used to rove through the forests when he was young.
words.ex_cn: 他年轻时常常在森林里漫游。
words.en: To rove means to travel constantly without a fixed destination; wander.

words.tr:
n. 鞭策；
v. 刺激；
words.ex: The competition served as a spur to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 竞争成了推动他更努力工作的鞭策。
words.en: A spur is something that makes you want to do something or that encourages you to do it. It can also refer to a sharp device worn on the heel of a rider's boot to urge a horse forward.

words.ex: The dog follows its owner every day.
words.ex_cn: 狗每天跟随它的主人。
words.en: To go or come after (a person or thing proceeding ahead); move or travel behind.

words.ex: The village is far from the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄远离城市。
words.en: If you say that something is far from a particular thing or far from being the case, you are emphasizing that it is not that particular thing or not at all the case, especially when people expect or assume that it is.

words.tr: abbr. 研究与发展；研发部门；“Research and Development”的缩写
words.ex: The company invests in r&d to create new products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司投资于研发以创造新产品。
words.en: R&D stands for Research and Development, which refers to the investigative activities a business conducts to improve existing products and procedures or to lead to the development of new products and procedures.

words.tr: phrase. 研究与开发；研发（简称R&D，指企业或机构为创造新产品、新技术或改进现有产品技术而进行的系统性工作）
words.ex: The company spends a lot of money on research and development.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司花了很多钱在研究与开发上。
words.en: Research & Development (R&D) refers to the investigative activities a business conducts to improve existing products and procedures or to lead to the development of new products and procedures.

words.tr: phrase. 贡献；促成；导致；有助于
words.ex: Volunteers contribute to the clean-up of the park.
words.ex_cn: 志愿者们为公园的清洁做出了贡献。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.tr:
v. 防止；战斗；抑制；
n. 战斗；
words.ex: The new law aims to combat pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律旨在防止污染。
words.en: Combat refers to fighting, especially during a war. It can also mean to try to stop something harmful from happening or increasing.

words.ex: The bacterium causes sickness in humans.
words.ex_cn: 这种细菌会导致人类生病。
words.en: A bacterium is a very small organism which often causes disease.

words.ex: The bacterial infection made him very sick.
words.ex_cn: 细菌感染让他病得很重。
words.en: Relating to or caused by bacteria.

words.ex: Fertilization happens when the sperm meets the egg.
words.ex_cn: 当精子与卵子结合时，受精就发生了。
words.en: The process by which male and female gametes (sperm and egg) fuse to initiate the development of a new individual organism.

words.ex: Lizards can regenerate their tails.
words.ex_cn: 蜥蜴可以再生尾巴。
words.en: To regenerate means to grow or form again, especially after being damaged or lost, or to improve a place or system by making it more active or successful.

words.ex: Plants take in carbon dioxide from the air.
words.ex_cn: 植物从空气中吸收二氧化碳。
words.en: Carbon dioxide is a gas that is produced when people and animals breathe out, or when carbon is burned in the air. It is used by plants in photosynthesis.

words.ex: The kidneys excrete waste from the body.
words.ex_cn: 肾脏将废物排出体外。
words.en: If someone excretes waste matter from their body, they get rid of it in faeces, urine, or sweat.

words.ex: The Milky Way is our home galaxy.
words.ex_cn: 银河系是我们所在的星系。
words.en: A galaxy is an extremely large group of stars and planets that extends over many billions of light years.

words.tr: n. 热心者；热衷于…的人
words.ex: He is an enthusiast of basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他是篮球的爱好者。
words.en: An enthusiast is a person who is very interested in a particular activity or subject and who spends a lot of time on it.

words.tr: n. 副产品 ；让产易股；资产分派
words.ex: The movie was a spin-off of the popular TV series.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是那部热门电视剧的副产品。
words.en: A spin-off is something that develops from something larger or more important, especially a television program or film that is based on a character or idea from an existing one.

words.tr: v. 兜售；招徕；吹捧；倒卖（高价票）
words.ex: He touts the new phone as the best on the market.
words.ex_cn: 他吹捧这款新手机是市场上最好的。
words.en: If someone touts something, they try to sell it or convince people that it is good, especially in an aggressive or exaggerated way.

words.ex: He bought an extravagant car that cost too much money.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一辆奢侈的车，价格太贵了。
words.en: Spending much more than is necessary or wise; excessively expensive.

words.tr: n. 船坞；造船厂；修船厂；船舶修理所
words.ex: The shipyard builds large boats for the navy.
words.ex_cn: 造船厂为海军建造大型船只。
words.en: A shipyard is a place where ships are built or repaired.

words.ex: They drank champagne at the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他们在婚礼上喝了香槟。
words.en: Champagne is an expensive French white wine with bubbles in. It is often drunk to celebrate something.

words.tr:
n. 系绳；系链；界限
v. 用绳拴住
words.ex: The horse was tied to the post with a tether.
words.ex_cn: 这匹马被用拴绳系在了柱子上。
words.en: A tether is a rope or chain used to tie an animal to a post or other fixed point so that it cannot move away.

words.tr:
v. 投入；跳入
n. 跳进；骤降
words.ex: He plunged into the cold water.
words.ex_cn: 他跳进了冰冷的水里。
words.en: If something or someone plunges in a particular direction, especially into water, they fall, rush, or throw themselves in that direction.

words.tr: phrase. 发射台，发射站：用于发射火箭或其他航天器的表面或结构。
words.ex: The rocket was assembled on the launch pad.
words.ex_cn: 火箭在发射台上组装完成。
words.en: A launch pad is a platform from which a rocket or missile is launched into space or the atmosphere.

words.ex: The submarine sailed quietly under the sea.
words.ex_cn: 潜水艇在海底安静地航行。
words.en: A submarine is a type of ship that can travel underwater. It is used primarily by the military for defense purposes, but some are used for scientific research.

words.ex: He showed me around the school.
words.ex_cn: 他带我参观了学校。
words.en: to guide someone on a tour of a place, making them familiar with it

words.ex: The company streamlined its hiring process.
words.ex_cn: 公司简化了招聘流程。
words.en: To make something such as a business, organization, or process work more effectively by making it simpler or more efficient.

words.ex: He was busy at the moment.
words.ex_cn: 当时他很忙。
words.en: At the moment is used to indicate that something is happening now.

words.ex: The old building will implode if the explosives go off.
words.ex_cn: 如果炸药引爆，这座旧楼会坍塌。
words.en: If something implodes, it collapses into itself in a sudden and violent way.

words.tr: phrase. 第一手地；直接地（指亲自获得信息或经验，而非通过他人转述）
words.ex: She learned first hand about the earthquake from a survivor.
words.ex_cn: 她从幸存者那里第一手了解了地震的情况。
words.en: Received directly from the original source.

words.tr: phrase. 第一手地；直接地（指亲自获得信息或经验，而非通过他人转述）
words.ex: He saw the accident at first hand.
words.ex_cn: 他亲眼目睹了那场事故。
words.en: If you experience or learn something at first hand, you experience or learn it yourself rather than being told about it by someone else.

words.ex: They collaborate with their classmates on homework.
words.ex_cn: 他们和同学一起合作做作业。
words.en: Work jointly with someone or a group to achieve a common goal.

words.ex: The company has an offshore office in Ireland.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司在爱尔兰有一个离岸办公室。
words.en: Located or based in a foreign country, especially to take advantage of lower costs or less stringent regulations.

words.tr: n. 胡同（尤指中国北京老城区的）
words.ex: The hutong is a unique feature of Beijing's old city.
words.ex_cn: 胡同是北京老城区的一个独特特征。
words.en: A hutong is a type of narrow street or alley commonly associated with northern Chinese cities, especially Beijing.

words.ex: Her success is a reflection of her good karma.
words.ex_cn: 她的成功是她善业的体现。
words.en: In Hinduism and Buddhism, karma is the belief that all actions have consequences which affect a person's future, either in this life or in a future life.

words.tr: phrase. 经过；通过；经历；经历并完成
words.ex: We pass through the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天早上都穿过公园。
words.en: To move or travel through a place or area.

words.ex: They laid new tile in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 他们在厨房铺了新的瓷砖。
words.en: A tile is a flat piece of baked clay, carpet, cork, or other material, used especially for covering roofs and floors.

words.tr:
n. 特点；特性；
adj. 典型的；特有的；
words.ex: Honesty is a key characteristic of a good friend.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一个好朋友的关键特点。
words.en: A characteristic is a quality or feature that is typical of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 具有...特色的；为…所特有
words.ex: This noise is characteristic of a broken engine.
words.ex_cn: 这种噪音是发动机坏了的特征。
words.en: To be typical of a particular person or thing.

words.tr:
n. 结构；建筑物；
v. 组织；
words.ex: The structure of the bridge is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥的结构非常坚固。
words.en: The arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex.

words.tr: n. 街坊；四邻；街道；附近地区；
words.ex: I walk my dog in the neighborhood every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上在街坊遛狗。
words.en: A neighborhood is one of the parts of a town where people live.

words.ex: The two colors distinguish the two teams.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色使两个队伍有所不同。
words.en: If you can distinguish one thing from another, you can see or understand how they are different.

words.ex: His residence is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他的住所靠近公园。
words.en: A residence is a house or place where someone lives.

words.tr: phrase. 在...扮演一个角色；起作用
words.ex: Exercise plays a role in staying healthy.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼在保持健康方面起作用。
words.en: To have a part or influence in something.

words.tr: adj. 群体的；社区的；公有的；
words.ex: They share a communal kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 他们共用一个群体厨房。
words.en: Communal means relating to or shared by all the members of a community.

words.tr:
n. 捆；束；包
v. 匆匆送走
words.ex: He bought a bundle of newspapers.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一捆报纸。
words.en: A bundle is a number of things that are tied or wrapped together so that they can be carried or stored easily.

words.tr: phrase. 包起来；裹紧（衣物）；收拾整理
words.ex: He bundled up before going out in the snow.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿得很暖和。
words.en: To dress warmly, especially by wearing multiple layers of clothing, or to wrap something tightly in cloth or paper.

words.ex: The vendor sells fresh fruits at the market.
words.ex_cn: 这个商贩在市场卖新鲜水果。
words.en: A vendor is a person or company that sells goods or services.

words.tr: phrase. 增加；提升；加紧；走上前
words.ex: He will step up to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他将挺身而出帮助他的朋友。
words.en: To increase the amount, speed, or intensity of something.

words.tr: n. （政治、商业或社会性）活动；运动；
words.ex: The city launched a campaign to reduce plastic waste.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市发起了一项减少塑料垃圾的活动。
words.en: A campaign is a planned set of activities that people carry out over a period of time in order to achieve something such as social or political change.

words.tr:
n. 主人；主持人；
v. 主持；
words.ex: The host welcomed us with tea and cookies.
words.ex_cn: 主人用茶和饼干欢迎了我们。
words.en: A host is a person who receives or entertains guests, especially in their own home. A host is also a person who presents a television or radio program.

words.tr:
n. 痕迹；轨迹；微量；
v. 追踪；追溯；仔细查找；
words.ex: There was no trace of blood on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 地板上没有血迹。
words.en: If you trace something such as a pattern or a shape, you draw it carefully over a piece of thin paper. You can also trace someone or something that is missing or has disappeared, by following their movements or actions.

words.tr:
v. 促进；使增长；
n. 提高；增强；
words.ex: Exercise can boost your energy.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进你的精力。
words.en: If one thing boosts another, it causes it to increase, improve, or be more successful.

words.tr: n. 运动竞赛；竞技热；崇尚运动；运动能力
words.ex: His athleticism helped him win the race.
words.ex_cn: 他的运动竞赛能力帮助他赢得了比赛。
words.en: Athleticism refers to the physical qualities that are characteristic of athletes, such as strength, fitness, and agility.

words.tr:
n. 旋转；
v. 旋转；
words.ex: The spin of the top made it stay upright.
words.ex_cn: 陀螺的旋转让它保持直立。
words.en: If something spins or if you spin it, it turns quickly around a central point.

words.ex: The clever boy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个聪明的男孩很快解决了这道数学题。
words.en: Someone who is clever is intelligent and able to understand things easily or plan things well.

words.tr:
n. 摇摆；
v. 摇摆；
words.ex: The child enjoyed the swing at the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子喜欢在公园里荡秋千。
words.en: If something swings or if you swing it, it moves repeatedly backwards and forwards or from side to side from a fixed point. If you swing somewhere, you move there by holding onto something and moving your body through the air.

words.ex: The pendulum swings back and forth in the clock.
words.ex_cn: 钟摆在钟里来回摆动。
words.en: A pendulum is a weight that is hung from a fixed point so that it can swing freely, especially a rod with a weight at the end that regulates the mechanism of a clock.

words.ex: The wind scatter the leaves everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 风把树叶吹得四处分散。
words.en: To scatter means to throw or drop things over a wide area in an irregular way, or to cause a group of people or animals to move apart in different directions.

words.tr:
v. 把…塞进狭窄的空间；把…藏入
n. 褶皱；零食
words.ex: He tucked the letter into his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他把信塞进了口袋里。
words.en: If you tuck something somewhere, you put it there so that it is safe, comfortable, or neat.

words.ex: He does a daily workout at the gym.
words.ex_cn: 他每天在健身房健身。
words.en: A session of vigorous physical exercise or training.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 闲逛；逗留；在附近徘徊
words.ex: He hangs around the park after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后在公园闲逛。
words.en: To spend time somewhere without any particular purpose or activity.

words.tr: n. 公共卫生；卫生设施；
words.ex: The city improved sanitation to keep people healthy.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改善了公共卫生以保障人民健康。
words.en: The conditions and processes that help maintain health and prevent disease, especially through cleanliness.

words.tr: phrase. 在……的最前面；位于……的首位；领导……
words.ex: He is at the head of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在班级的最前面。
words.en: At the head of means to be in the leading position in a group or organization, or to be in charge of it.

words.ex: The factory has installed infrared-automated systems to improve efficiency.
words.ex_cn: 工厂安装了红外自动化系统以提高效率。
words.en: Operated or controlled by infrared technology, often for automation or detection.

words.tr: v. 授权；命名；给...权利（或资格）
words.ex: This book entitles you to a free gift.
words.ex_cn: 这本书使你有资格获得一份免费礼物。
words.en: If you are entitled to something, you have the right to have it or do it.

words.ex: He is entitled to free healthcare.
words.ex_cn: 他有权享受免费医疗。
words.en: If you are entitled to something, you have the right to have it or do it.

words.tr:
v. 回忆起；召回；
n. 记忆力；
words.ex: I recall my first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 我想起了我上学的第一天。
words.en: If you recall something, you remember it and tell others about it.

words.tr: adj. 急剧的；引人注目的；戏剧（性）的；
words.ex: There was a dramatic increase in temperature yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天温度急剧上升。
words.en: If something is dramatic, it happens or changes suddenly and noticeably.

words.tr: n. 优势；有利条件；好处；
words.ex: His height gives him an advantage in basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他的身高在篮球中给了他优势。
words.en: An advantage is a factor or circumstance that puts you in a favorable or superior position.

words.ex: He took advantage of the free tickets.
words.ex_cn: 他利用了免费的票。
words.en: To use a particular situation to do or get what you want.

words.ex: The river forms the border between the two countries.
words.ex_cn: 这条河是两个国家的边界。
words.en: The edge or boundary of something, or the part near it; a dividing line.

words.ex: He found a ripped-up piece of paper in the trash.
words.ex_cn: 他在垃圾里发现了一张撕碎的纸片。
words.en: Something that is ripped-up has been torn into pieces or damaged by being pulled apart.

words.tr: v. 贡献；促成；捐献；投稿；
words.ex: He contributes money to the charity.
words.ex_cn: 他向慈善机构捐款。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.tr: phrase. 与...在一起；沿着；除此之外，还…
words.ex: He bought apples along with oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他买了苹果，还买了橙子。
words.en: in addition to someone or something else; together with someone or something else

words.tr:
n. 库存；股票；家畜；
v. 备有；贮存；
words.ex: The store has low stock of winter coats.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店的冬衣库存很少。
words.en: The supply of goods available for sale in a store; the capital raised by a company through the issue of shares.

words.tr: phrase. 开放；易受到；易遭受
words.ex_cn: 他愿意接受新想法。
words.en: To be willing to consider or accept something.

words.tr:
n. 纠纷；争端；
v. 对（某事）有异议；
words.ex: The dispute between the two neighbors was about the fence.
words.ex_cn: 两个邻居之间的纠纷是关于篱笆的。
words.en: A dispute is a disagreement or argument about something important.

words.tr:
n. 烤架；铁格子
v. 烧烤；拷问
words.ex: He cooked the burgers on the grill.
words.ex_cn: 他用烤架烤了汉堡。
words.en: To cook food on a metal frame over a fire, or a metal frame used for cooking food in this way.

words.ex: Please attend to your homework now.
words.ex_cn: 现在请专心做你的作业。
words.en: To deal with or take care of something; to give attention to someone or something.

words.ex: He got a driver's license last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周拿到了驾照。
words.en: A license is an official document which gives you permission to do, use, or own something.

words.tr:
n. 串肉扦；烤肉叉
v. 用扦子串住；将…叉住
words.ex: He put the meat on a skewer and grilled it.
words.ex_cn: 他把肉串在串肉扦上烤。
words.en: A skewer is a long pin made of wood or metal, used for holding together pieces of food, especially meat, during cooking.

words.tr: phrase. 创造历史；做出载入史册的壮举
words.ex: They will make history with their big idea.
words.ex_cn: 他们将用他们的大创意创造历史。
words.en: To do something so important that it will be recorded in history.

words.ex: He acquired a new skill last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了一项新技能。
words.en: If you acquire something, you buy or obtain it for yourself, or someone gives it to you.

words.tr:
v. 嘲笑；嘲弄；
adj. 仿制的；
words.ex: They mock him for his accent.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为他口音而嘲笑他。
words.en: To mock someone means to laugh at them, tease them, or make them look foolish, often by imitating their behavior or speech.

words.ex: It is obvious that he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 很明显他很累。
words.en: If something is obvious, it is easy to see or understand.

words.ex: The layout of the room makes it feel bigger.
words.ex_cn: 房间的布局让它显得更大。
words.en: The way in which the parts of something are arranged or laid out.

words.ex: The vase remained intact after the fall.
words.ex_cn: 花瓶从高处摔下后依然完整无缺。
words.en: Something that is intact is complete and has not been damaged or changed.

words.ex: A hawk flew over the field.
words.ex_cn: 一只鹰飞过田野。
words.en: A hawk is a bird of prey with a strong beak and sharp claws, known for its keen vision and swift flight. As a verb, to hawk means to sell goods aggressively, often in public places.

words.tr:
n. 厄运；毁灭；死亡
v. 注定；判决
words.ex: The old prophecy spoke of doom for the kingdom.
words.ex_cn: 古老的预言说这个王国将遭遇厄运。
words.en: Doom is a terrible fate or destiny that you cannot avoid, especially death or destruction.

words.tr: adj. 心情愉快的；脾气好的
words.ex: She greeted everyone with a good-humored smile.
words.ex_cn: 她以愉快的心情微笑着迎接每个人。
words.en: Someone who is good-humored is cheerful and not easily made angry.

words.ex: He dwells in a small house near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他住在湖边的一所小房子里。
words.en: If you dwell on something, especially something unpleasant, you think, speak, or write about it a lot or for quite a long time.

words.tr: phrase. v. 老是想着；过分关注（某事）； dwelling on 指反复思考或谈论不愉快的事
words.ex: He doesn't dwell on his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他不会纠结于自己的错误。
words.en: If you dwell on something, especially something unpleasant, you think, speak, or write about it a lot or for quite a long time.

words.tr: n. 摧毁；拆毁；拆除；大败；
words.ex: The demolition of the old building started last week.
words.ex_cn: 那座旧楼的拆除上周开始了。
words.en: The act of demolishing something, especially a building.

words.ex: He will move out next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周要搬出去。
words.en: To leave a place where you have been living and go to live somewhere else.

words.tr: n. 差额；边缘；净利润；余地；
words.ex: The profit margin is five dollars.
words.ex_cn: 利润差额是五美元。
words.en: The margin is the edge or border of something, or the difference between two amounts, especially the difference between the cost of producing something and the price it is sold for.

words.ex: The essence of love is caring for others.
words.ex_cn: 爱的本质是关心他人。
words.en: The essence of something is its basic and most important characteristic which gives it its individual identity.

words.tr: adj. 务实的；实事求是的；
words.ex: He took a pragmatic approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他采取了务实的方法来解决问题。
words.en: Dealing with things sensibly and realistically in a way that is based on practical rather than theoretical considerations.

words.tr: adj. 资源丰富的；机敏的；足智多谋的
words.ex: He is a resourceful man who can fix anything with little material.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个资源丰富的男人，能用很少的材料修好任何东西。
words.en: If someone is resourceful, they are good at finding ways of dealing with problems.

words.ex: He threatened to call the police.
words.ex_cn: 他威胁要叫警察。
words.en: If someone threatens to do something unpleasant to you, or if they threaten you, they say or imply that they will do something unpleasant to you, especially if you do not do what they want.

words.tr:
adj. 最初的；开始的；
n. 首字母；
words.ex: This is the initial plan for the project.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个项目的最初计划。
words.en: The first letter of a name or word, used to represent the whole name or word.

words.ex: The army stopped the incursion at the border.
words.ex_cn: 军队在边境阻止了入侵。
words.en: An incursion is a sudden attack on or invasion of a place.

words.ex: Water is made of two elements: hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 水由两种要素组成：氢和氧。
words.en: An element is a substance that cannot be separated into simpler substances by chemical means and is composed of atoms having the same number of protons.

words.tr: phrase. 抽出；（昼夜）变长；使畅所欲言
words.ex: He drew out a key from his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他从口袋里抽出一把钥匙。
words.en: To make something last longer than usual or to encourage someone to talk or express their feelings.

words.ex: He is a creative boy who draws nice pictures.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有创造力的男孩，会画漂亮的画。
words.en: Someone who is creative has the ability to invent and develop original ideas, especially in the arts.

words.tr:
n. 常规；例行公事；
adj. 常规的；例行公事的；
words.ex: He follows a morning routine every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都遵循固定的惯例。
words.en: A routine is a sequence of actions regularly followed; a fixed program.

words.ex: They will move in next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们下周搬进来。
words.en: To begin living in a new home or place.

words.ex: They move into a new house next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们下周搬进新房子。
words.en: To begin living in a new home or place.

words.tr: phrase. 搬到；迁移到；移动到；转移到
words.ex: They want to move to a new house next month.
words.ex_cn: 他们想下个月搬到一个新房子。
words.en: To relocate to a different place or position.

words.tr: v. 暂停；中止；延期； suspending
words.ex: The school will suspend the class due to snow.
words.ex_cn: 由于下雪，学校将暂停课程。
words.en: If you suspend something, you delay it or stop it from happening for a while or until a decision is made about it.

words.ex: The prince rode a white horse through the castle gate.
words.ex_cn: 王子骑着一匹白马穿过城堡的大门。
words.en: A prince is a male member of a royal family, especially the son of a king or queen.

words.ex: He went to the embassy to get a visa.
words.ex_cn: 他去大使馆办理签证。
words.en: An embassy is a group of officials who represent their country in a foreign country, or the building where they work.

words.ex: The goddess appeared in her incarnation as a bird.
words.ex_cn: 女神以鸟的化身出现。
words.en: The embodiment of a deity or spirit in some earthly form; a person who embodies in the flesh a deity, spirit, or quality.

words.tr:
adj. 巨大的；强大的；
adv. 非常；
words.ex: The mighty river flows through the valley.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的河流流经山谷。
words.en: Possessing great power, strength, or force; formidable.

words.tr: phrase. 使倒下；击倒；保持低调；隐匿行踪
words.ex: He decided to lay low after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 争吵后他决定低调行事。
words.en: To keep a low profile or to stay hidden, especially to avoid attention or trouble.

words.ex: He stood amid the trees, quiet and still.
words.ex_cn: 他站在树木中间，安静而静止。
words.en: If something is amid other things, it is surrounded by them.

words.ex: The colors of the painting fade in the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的颜色在阳光下逐渐消失。
words.en: To gradually grow faint and disappear.

words.tr:
n. 艰苦跋涉；
v. 长途跋涉；
words.ex: The trek across the mountains took five days.
words.ex_cn: 穿越群山的艰苦跋涉花了五天时间。
words.en: A trek is a long and often difficult journey, especially one made on foot.

words.tr: 短语. 在某人状态或能力的顶峰时期
words.ex: He is at his peak when he plays basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他打篮球时正处于巅峰状态。
words.en: At the highest or best point of someone's abilities or performance.

words.tr: phrase. 在……的顶峰；在……的最高点
words.ex: She was at the peak of her career when she won the award.
words.ex_cn: 她在事业达到顶峰时获得了这个奖项。
words.en: At the highest point or level of something.

words.tr: n. 黄昏；薄暮；暮光；衰退期
words.ex: The birds fly home at twilight.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在黄昏时飞回家。
words.en: The time of day immediately following sunset, or the period of time at the end of the day when the sun is just below the horizon, especially the period between sunset and dark.

words.ex: He will depart tomorrow morning.
words.ex_cn: 他明天早上离开。
words.en: If you depart from a place, you leave it and start a journey to another place.

words.ex: Our forefather built this village long ago.
words.ex_cn: 我们的祖先很久以前建造了这个村庄。
words.en: Your forefathers are your ancestors, especially the male ones.

words.ex: The exodus of people from the city happened after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 洪水之后，大批人离开了这座城市。
words.en: An exodus is a situation in which many people leave a place at the same time.

words.ex: The apple plummeted from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 苹果从树上垂直落下。
words.en: If an amount, rate, or price plummets, it decreases quickly by a large amount.

words.ex: He was charged with stealing a car.
words.ex_cn: 他被指控偷了一辆车。
words.en: If someone is charged with a crime, they are officially accused of it and will be judged in a court of law.

words.tr:
n. 倒塌；崩溃；暴跌；
v. 倒塌；崩溃；
words.ex: The collapse of the old bridge caused many problems.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧桥的倒塌引起了诸多问题。
words.en: If a building or other structure collapses, it falls down very suddenly.

words.ex: The farmer stores hay in the barn.
words.ex_cn: 农夫把干草存放在谷仓里。
words.en: A barn is a large building on a farm in which crops or animals are kept.

words.ex: The rabbit lives in a small hutch.
words.ex_cn: 兔子住在一个小兔舍里。
words.en: A hutch is a type of cage or pen used to house small animals, especially rabbits, or a piece of furniture with shelves and a cupboard.

words.ex: The cowshed is near the barn.
words.ex_cn: 牛棚在谷仓附近。
words.en: A cowshed is a building where cows are kept.

words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.ex: The rickety table wobbled when I put my book on it.
words.ex_cn: 这张不结实的桌子当我把书放上去时晃动了。
words.en: Likely to fall or collapse; shaky.

words.tr: adj. 激起性欲的；满足感官的；撩人的
words.ex: The painting showed a voluptuous woman with flowing curves.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画描绘了一位身材性感、曲线优美的女人。
words.en: If you describe a woman as voluptuous, you mean that she has large breasts and hips and is considered sexually attractive.

words.ex: The doctor advised him to drink more water to help him urinate more frequently.
words.ex_cn: 医生建议他多喝水，以帮助他更频繁地排尿。
words.en: To urinate means to pass urine from the body.

words.tr: adj. 像讣告的；类似讣告风格的
words.ex: The tone of the article was obituary-esque, focusing on the life and accomplishments of the deceased.
words.ex_cn: 文章的语气像讣告，着重于逝者的生活和成就。
words.en: Resembling or characteristic of an obituary, especially in being mournful or commemorative.

words.ex: She lamented the death of her dog.
words.ex_cn: 她哀悼她狗的去世。
words.en: If you lament something, you express your sadness, regret, or disappointment about it.

words.tr: adj. 即将发生的；临近的；
words.ex: An imminent storm is coming soon.
words.ex_cn: 一场即将发生的风暴很快就要来了。
words.en: If you say that something is imminent, especially something unpleasant, you mean it is almost certain to happen very soon.

words.ex: The family is in a difficult plight after losing their home.
words.ex_cn: 这家人在失去家园后陷入了困境。
words.en: A plight is a difficult or adverse situation, especially one that is hard to escape. It can also refer to a solemn promise or pledge.

words.ex: The significance of this discovery changed science.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现的重要性改变了科学。
words.en: The quality of being worthy of attention; importance.

words.ex: Please vacate the room by noon.
words.ex_cn: 请在中午前腾出房间。
words.en: To vacate a place or position means to leave it or give it up, making it available for other people.

words.tr: n. 重新定居；移居；重新安置
words.ex: The government is planning the resettlement of refugees.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在计划重新安置难民。
words.en: The process of moving people to a new place to live, especially because of a war, natural disaster, or other problem.

words.ex: He works hard to earn his subsistence.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以维持生计。
words.en: Subsistence is the condition of just having enough food or money to stay alive.

words.tr: n. 艾登蒂基特容貌拼图；（罪犯的）合成人像；千篇一律的东西; adj. 普通无奇的；公式化的；规格...
words.ex: The police used an identikit to create a composite image of the suspect.
words.ex_cn: 警方使用艾登蒂基特容貌拼图来创建嫌疑人的合成图像。
words.en: A method of constructing a visual representation of a person's face from a witness's description, using a set of transparencies showing different facial features.

words.tr:
v. 吹嘘；自夸
n. 吹嘘；自夸
words.ex: He likes to vaunt his new car.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢炫耀他的新车。
words.en: To boast about or praise (something) excessively.

words.ex: There is a resemblance between the two brothers.
words.ex_cn: 这两兄弟之间有相似之处。
words.en: If there is a resemblance between two people or things, they are similar to each other.

words.tr: phrase. 与……相像；与……有相似之处
words.ex: He bear a resemblance to his father.
words.ex_cn: 他和他父亲长得很像。
words.en: If one thing or person bears a resemblance to another, they are similar to each other.

words.ex: This story does not bear any resemblance to the real event.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事与真实事件毫无相似之处。
words.en: To have no similarity or likeness to someone or something.

words.ex: He loves the bucolic life in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢乡村的田园生活。
words.en: Relating to the pleasant aspects of the countryside and country life.

words.ex: He couldn't budge the heavy box.
words.ex_cn: 他无法让那个重箱子稍微移动一下。
words.en: If someone will not budge on a matter, or if nothing budges them, they refuse to change their mind or to come to an agreement.

words.ex: His loyalty to his friends never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友的忠诚从未改变。
words.en: The quality of being loyal to someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 退居次要位置；不积极参与；让别人主导
words.ex: After the new manager arrived, John decided to take a back seat and let her lead the project.
words.ex_cn: 新经理到来后，约翰决定退居次要地位，让她来领导项目。
words.en: To take a less active or prominent role in something; to allow others to lead or take charge.

words.w: take a back seat to sth.
words.tr: phrase. 退居次要地位；让位于某事物
words.ex: In the new company structure, the marketing department will have to take a back seat to the sales department.
words.ex_cn: 在新公司结构中，市场部将不得不让位于销售部。
words.en: To allow something else to be more important or to have priority over something.

words.w: take a back seat to sb.
words.tr: phrase. 甘居次位；让位于某人；不居主导地位
words.uk: teɪk ə bæk siːt tuː ˈsʌmbədi
words.us: teɪk ə bæk siːt tuː ˈsʌmbədi
words.ex: In this company, the CEO always takes a back seat to the board of directors.
words.ex_cn: 在这家公司，首席执行官总是让位于董事会。
words.en: To allow someone else to take a leading or more important role than oneself.

words.tr: n. 实用主义；务实思想
words.ex: He shows pragmatism by choosing the cheapest option.
words.ex_cn: 他选择最便宜的选项，体现了务实精神。
words.en: Pragmatism is a way of dealing with problems in a practical way rather than by following theories or principles.

words.ex: He sat by the window to ponder his future.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在窗边深思自己的未来。
words.en: If you ponder something, you think about it carefully.

words.ex: He can foretell the weather by looking at the sky.
words.ex_cn: 他可以通过观察天空来预知天气。
words.en: To tell or indicate beforehand; predict.

words.ex: The megalopolis is home to millions of people.
words.ex_cn: 这个特大都市是数百万人的家园。
words.en: A very large, densely populated urban complex, typically consisting of several cities merging together.

words.ex: He plays the cello every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上拉大提琴。
words.en: A cello is a large stringed instrument of the violin family, tuned an octave below the viola.

words.ex: The sky is dotted with stars.
words.ex_cn: 天空布满了星星。
words.en: To be scattered or sprinkled with something, typically in a way that creates a pattern or design.

words.ex: A handful of students stayed after class to ask questions.
words.ex_cn: 少数学生课后留下来提问。
words.en: A handful of something is a small amount of it, especially when it is not enough or when it is difficult to manage.

words.tr: phrase. 一把；一撮；少数的；少量的
words.ex: He picked up a handful of sand.
words.ex_cn: 他抓了一把沙子。
words.en: A small number or amount of something.

words.ex: The two companies will merge next year.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司明年将合并。
words.en: To combine or unite to form a single entity.

words.ex: The two companies decided to merge with each other to increase their market share.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司决定相互合并以增加市场份额。
words.en: Combine or unite into a single entity, such as companies or groups.

words.tr: v. （使）窒息而死；使呼吸困难；闷死
words.ex: The smoke is suffocating him.
words.ex_cn: 烟雾正在让他窒息。
words.en: To cause someone to die or to make it difficult for someone to breathe by preventing air from reaching the lungs.

words.tr: adj. 令人窒息的；使人呼吸困难的；憋气的（suffocate 的 ing 形式）
words.ex: The smoke made the room suffocating.
words.ex_cn: 烟雾让房间令人窒息。
words.en: If you say that something is suffocating, you mean that it makes you feel uncomfortable because there is not enough fresh air and it is difficult to breathe.

words.tr: n. 优势；有利条件；好处；
words.ex: His height gives him an advantage in basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他的身高在篮球中给了他优势。
words.en: An advantage is a factor or circumstance that puts you in a favorable or superior position.

words.ex: The city plans to urbanize the village next year.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市计划明年将这个村庄城市化。
words.en: To make an area more urban by building houses, industries, and other facilities.

words.ex: He is an undocumented worker in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他是这座城市里一名无正式文件的工人。
words.en: Not having the necessary documents or official papers to prove something, especially legal status.

words.ex: The migrant found a new job in the city.
words.ex_cn: 这位移居者在城市里找到了一份新工作。
words.en: A migrant is a person who moves from one place to another, especially in order to find work.

words.ex: The inhabitant lives in a small house.
words.ex_cn: 这位居民住在一所小房子里。
words.en: An inhabitant of a place is one of the people who live there.

words.ex: A multitude of people attended the festival.
words.ex_cn: 大量的人参加了这个节日。
words.en: A multitude of things or people is a very large number of them.

words.tr: v. 重新定位；使适应；改变方针；调整
words.ex: He had to reorient his goals after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他在失业后不得不重新调整自己的目标。
words.en: To change the focus or direction of something.

words.tr:
v. 启动；开始
n. 启动；开始
words.ex: The company decided to kick-start the project with additional funding.
words.ex_cn: 公司决定用额外的资金来启动这个项目。
words.en: To start something quickly or forcefully, especially a process or project.

words.tr: n. 发电厂；精力旺盛的人；强大的集团（或组织）
words.ex: The old powerhouse still provides electricity for the town.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧发电厂仍为这个城镇供电。
words.en: A powerhouse is an organization or country that is very strong or important, or a person who is very energetic.

words.tr:
n. 群；团；簇；
v. 聚集；
words.ex: The stars form a bright cluster in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 星星在夜空中形成了一群明亮的星群。
words.en: A cluster of things or people is a small group of them close together.

words.tr: adj. 迷失方向的； v. “disorient”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt disoriented after the power went out.
words.ex_cn: 停电后他感到迷失方向。
words.en: If you are disoriented, you have lost your sense of direction, or you feel confused and not sure where you are or what you should do.

words.ex: The soldiers stayed at the remote outpost.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们驻守在偏远的前哨站。
words.en: An outpost is a small military camp or position at some distance from the main army, used especially as a guard against surprise attack.

words.tr:
n. 巡逻
v. 巡逻
words.ex: The police patrol the street at night.
words.ex_cn: 警察晚上在街上巡逻。
words.en: A patrol is a group of soldiers or vehicles that are guarding a place at a particular time. Patrol can also refer to the act of moving around an area or building at regular times to check that it is safe.

words.ex: The guard stood on the watchtower.
words.ex_cn: 守卫站在瞭望塔上。
words.en: A watchtower is a tall structure from which people can look out for enemies or intruders.

words.ex: He pushed the trolley to carry the groceries.
words.ex_cn: 他推着手推车来搬购物品。
words.en: A trolley is a small vehicle with wheels that can be pushed or pulled along and is used for carrying things.

words.tr: 短语. 赚钱地；以获利的方式
words.ex: He sold the car at a profit.
words.ex_cn: 他以盈利的方式卖了这辆车。
words.en: If you sell something at a profit, you make a profit from selling it.

words.ex: All of a sudden, the dog started barking.
words.ex_cn: 突然间，狗开始叫了。
words.en: If something happens all of a sudden, it happens quickly and unexpectedly.

words.ex: The crane lifted the heavy steel beam.
words.ex_cn: 起重机吊起了沉重的钢梁。
words.en: A crane is a large machine that moves heavy things by lifting them in the air. It is also a large bird with long legs and a long neck.

words.tr: phrase. 举起；张贴；建造；进行；提供；推举；提供食宿
words.ex: He put up his hand to ask a question.
words.ex_cn: 他举起了手来提问。
words.en: To provide someone with a place to stay temporarily; to build or erect something; to raise or lift something; to propose or suggest something; to display or post something; to increase the price of something.

words.ex: He took a temporary job during summer.
words.ex_cn: 他在暑假期间做了一份短暂的工作。
words.en: Something that is temporary lasts for only a limited time.

words.ex: They used cement to build the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他们用水泥建造了这堵墙。
words.en: Cement is a powdery substance which is mixed with water and used for sticking things together or for making very hard surfaces.

words.tr:
v. 指拨（款 项）；指定（特殊用途）
n. 耳记；特征
words.ex: The government will earmark money for schools.
words.ex_cn: 政府将为学校拨款。
words.en: To designate or set aside something, especially funds, for a specific purpose.

words.ex: The team comprises five players and one coach.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队包括五名球员和一名教练。
words.en: If you say that something comprises or is comprised of a number of things or people, you mean it has them as its parts or members.

words.tr: adj. 超连接的；高度互联的
words.ex: The city is known for its ultra-connected infrastructure.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市以其高度互联的基础设施而闻名。
words.en: Extremely connected, especially in terms of communication or information technology.

words.ex: The valiant soldier fought bravely to protect his team.
words.ex_cn: 这位勇敢的士兵英勇战斗以保护他的队友。
words.en: Someone who is valiant is very brave and determined, especially in a difficult situation.

words.tr: v. 侵入；侵占；侵犯；侵蚀
words.ex: The new building encroaches on the park.
words.ex_cn: 新建筑侵占了公园。
words.en: To gradually take something such as power or authority from someone else, often in a way that is not fair or legal.

words.ex: He pressed the button to speed up the video.
words.ex_cn: 他按了按钮来加快视频速度。
words.en: To increase the speed or rate of something.

words.ex: The doctor sensed the urgency and acted quickly.
words.ex_cn: 医生感受到了紧急情况，迅速采取了行动。
words.en: The quality or condition of being urgent; pressing importance.

words.tr:
v. 派遣；调遣；发送
n. 快信；发送；派遣
words.ex: He will dispatch the package tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会寄出这个包裹。
words.en: To send someone or something to a particular place for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
adj. 资深的；高级的；年长的；
n. 年长者；大四学生；
words.ex: He is a senior engineer with 20 years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有20年经验的资深工程师。
words.en: Higher in rank, status, or importance; older in age.

words.tr: n. 代理；副职；恶习；缺点；
words.ex: He acted as vice for the manager during her absence.
words.ex_cn: 在经理缺席期间，他担任代理。
words.en: A vice is a moral fault or weakness in someone's character.

words.ex: He is in charge of the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 他负责这个教室。
words.en: Having control over or responsibility for someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 笔记；便条；音调；注释；语气；
v. 注意；记录；
words.ex: I took notes during the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我在讲座期间做了笔记。
words.en: A note is a short piece of writing, a musical sound, or a piece of paper money. It can also mean to pay attention to something or to write something down.

words.ex: The old toy is worthless now.
words.ex_cn: 这个旧玩具现在毫无价值。
words.en: If something is worthless, it has no use or value.

words.ex: The main criterion for winning is fairness.
words.ex_cn: 获胜的主要标准是公平。
words.en: A criterion is a principle or standard by which something may be judged or decided.

words.ex: He computes the total cost quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快算出总成本。
words.en: If you compute a total, amount, or result, you calculate it.

words.tr: n. 代码；编码；行为准则；密码；法典；
words.ex: He wrote a simple code to solve the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一段简单的代码来解决这个数学问题。
words.en: A code is a system of words, letters, figures, or other symbols substituted for other words, letters, etc., especially for the purposes of secrecy. As a verb, it means to convert (a message or other information) into a code.

words.tr: phrase. 密切关注；对……有意；看中了
words.ex: I have my eye on a new bike at the store.
words.ex_cn: 我一直在关注商店里的一辆新自行车。
words.en: To have a strong desire to obtain or achieve something.

words.tr: phrase. 密切关注；对……感兴趣；有意得到
words.ex: He has his eyes on a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他看上了一辆新自行车。
words.en: To want something very much; to watch someone or something closely.

words.tr:
v. 把…归因于；由…引起；
n. 品质；属性；特征；属性；
words.ex: He attributes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归因于努力工作。
words.en: If you attribute something to an event or situation, you think that it was caused by that event or situation.

words.ex: The teacher will assess your homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天会评估你的作业。
words.en: to judge or decide the amount, value, quality, or importance of something

words.ex: Children develop cognitive skills as they grow.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在成长过程中发展认知能力。
words.en: Cognitive means relating to the mental process involved in knowing, learning, and understanding things.

words.tr: phrase. 在运行中；即时地；匆忙地；未预先准备地
words.ex: The software can make changes on the fly without needing to restart.
words.ex_cn: 这个软件可以即时做出更改，不需要重启。
words.en: To do something quickly and without preparation, often in response to a situation that has just arisen.

words.ex: They pull together to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他们齐心协力按时完成项目。
words.en: To work together as a team or group in order to achieve something.

words.ex: The system will validate your password.
words.ex_cn: 系统将验证你的密码。
words.en: To validate something such as a claim or statement means to prove or confirm that it is true or correct.

words.tr: n. 领导才能；领导地位；
words.ex: His leadership helped the team win the match.
words.ex_cn: 他的领导才能帮助团队赢得了比赛。
words.en: Leadership is the ability to lead, guide, or direct a group, organization, or country.

words.ex: I like fruits, in particular apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: Especially; more than other things or people.

words.ex: He likes tea, as opposed to coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: used to make a contrast between two things

words.ex: We will get there by bus.
words.ex_cn: 我们坐公交车去那里。
words.en: To reach a destination or to achieve success.

words.ex: He cares about his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他在乎他的朋友们。
words.en: If you care about something, you feel that it is important and are concerned about it.

words.ex: He is faced with a difficult problem.
words.ex_cn: 他面临一个困难的问题。
words.en: If you are faced with a problem or a difficult situation, you have to deal with it.

words.tr: phrase.  进入；干涉；介入；作短时访问
words.ex: He will step in to help when needed.
words.ex_cn: 当需要时，他会介入帮忙。
words.en: To become involved in a situation in order to help deal with a problem.

words.ex: He had to relinquish his seat to an old man.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不把座位让给一位老人。
words.en: If you relinquish something, such as power or control, you give it up, often unwillingly.

words.ex: He showed humility after winning the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他在赢得奖品后表现出了谦逊。
words.en: Humility is the quality of being humble and not thinking that you are better than other people.

words.ex: The paper proves his ownership of the house.
words.ex_cn: 这份文件证明了他对这所房子的物主身份。
words.en: Ownership is the state or fact of owning something.

words.tr: n. 高手；前途无量的人
words.ex: He's considered a hotshot in the tech industry.
words.ex_cn: 他被认为是科技行业的高手。
words.en: A hotshot is someone who is very successful or skillful in a particular area.

words.ex: The sheep graze on a high plateau.
words.ex_cn: 羊群在高高原上吃草。
words.en: A plateau is a large area of high and fairly flat land. It can also refer to a period during which there are no large changes.

words.tr: v. 承诺；犯（罪、错）；（公开地）表达意见；
words.ex: He commit to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺帮助他的朋友。
words.en: To commit means to carry out or perpetrate a mistake, crime, or immoral act; or to pledge or bind oneself to a certain course of action.

words.tr: adj. 基本的；基础的；根本的；
words.ex: Water is a fundamental need for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命的基本需求。
words.en: You use fundamental to describe things, activities, and principles that are very important or essential. They affect the basic nature of other things or are the most important element upon which other things depend.

words.ex: He is a genius in math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面是个天才。
words.en: Someone who is a genius is a person who is exceptionally intelligent or talented, especially in a particular field.

words.ex: He called his friend an idiot after the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他在犯错后称朋友是白痴。
words.en: An idiot is a person who is considered to be very stupid or foolish.

words.tr: phrase. 拼命地；猛烈地；非常；绝不（用于强调否定）
words.ex: He ran like hell when he saw the dog.
words.ex_cn: 他看到狗时跑得非常快。
words.en: Used to emphasize the intensity or extreme nature of an action or state.

words.ex: From my point of view, this is the best choice.
words.ex_cn: 在我看来，这是最好的选择。
words.en: A particular attitude or way of considering a matter.

words.ex: He has a big ego and likes to show off.
words.ex_cn: 他自尊心很强，喜欢炫耀。
words.en: Your ego is your opinion of your own worth. For example, if someone has a big ego, they think they are very important and valuable.

words.tr:
n. 金融；财务；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: He works in finance in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他在纽约从事金融工作。
words.en: Finance is the management of large amounts of money, especially by governments or large companies.

words.tr: phrase. 大部分时间；通常；多半时候
words.ex: Most of the time, he walks to school.
words.ex_cn: 大多数时候，他走路去学校。
words.en: On most occasions; usually.

words.ex: He ran fast to come up with the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: If you come up with a plan, idea, or solution, you think of it and suggest it.

words.tr: phrase. 弄乱；搞砸；犯错；使陷入困境
words.ex: He might mess up the plan if he doesn't listen.
words.ex_cn: 如果他不听，他可能会把计划搞砸。
words.en: To make a mistake or do something badly.

words.ex: Can you sum up the total cost?
words.ex_cn: 你能合计一下总费用吗？
words.en: If you sum something up, you briefly describe the main features or ideas of it.

words.tr: adj. 卓越的；杰出的；罕见的；特别的；
words.ex: She is an exceptional student who always gets top grades.
words.ex_cn: 她是一名卓越的学生，总是取得最高分。
words.en: An exceptional person or thing has some unusual quality or ability that makes them different from others.

words.tr: v. 兑现；递送；交付；发表；为…接生；
words.ex: He promised to deliver on his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺要兑现自己的目标。
words.en: To bring and hand over (a letter, parcel, or ordered goods) to the proper recipient or address.

words.ex: The country uses metric units for weight and distance.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家使用米制单位来衡量重量和距离。
words.en: A metric is a system of measurement that uses meters, liters, and grams as its basic units.

words.ex: Beware of the dog.
words.ex_cn: 当心那只狗。
words.en: to be cautious and alert to the dangers of.

words.tr: n. 代理人；代表；代理权；代理服务器
words.ex: He gave his friend a proxy to vote for him.
words.ex_cn: 他让朋友当他的代理人替他投票。
words.en: A proxy is a person or thing that is authorized to act on behalf of another, especially in voting or representing someone in a meeting.

words.ex: People are increasingly using smartphones.
words.ex_cn: 人们日益使用智能手机。
words.en: More and more; gradually becoming greater in amount or degree.

words.ex: The two companies worked together in collaboration.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司通过合作一起工作。
words.en: the act of working together with someone to produce or create something

words.ex: After a short break, he resumed his work.
words.ex_cn: 短暂休息后，他继续工作。
words.en: If you resume an activity or if it resumes, it begins again or continues after an interruption.

words.tr: n. 征兵人员；招聘人员
words.ex: The recruiter asked him to join the army.
words.ex_cn: 征兵人员让他参军。
words.en: A recruiter is a person whose job is to enlist or enroll people as employees, in the armed forces, etc.

words.tr:
v. 吹嘘；自吹自擂
adj. 一流的；极好的
words.ex: He brags about his new car.
words.ex_cn: 他炫耀自己的新车。
words.en: If you brag, you say in a very proud way that you have something or have done something.

words.ex: This information is relevant to our project.
words.ex_cn: 这些信息与我们的项目相关。
words.en: Something that is relevant to a situation or person is important or significant in that situation or to that person.

words.ex: The climbers reached the summit of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 登山者到达了山顶。
words.en: The highest point of a hill or mountain; a meeting between heads of government.

words.ex: The tailor made a new suit for the man.
words.ex_cn: 裁缝为这位男士做了一套新西装。
words.en: A tailor is a person whose job is to make men's clothes, especially suits, jackets, and trousers, that fit individual customers. As a verb, to tailor means to make or adapt something for a particular purpose or person.

words.ex: His dedication to teaching helped many students succeed.
words.ex_cn: 他对教学的奉献帮助了许多学生取得成功。
words.en: The act of dedicating or the state of being dedicated; commitment.

words.tr: phrase. 偶遇；偶然发现；使产生…印象
words.ex: I came across an old photo while cleaning my room.
words.ex_cn: 我在打扫房间时发现了一张旧照片。
words.en: If you come across something or someone, you find them or meet them by chance.

words.tr: phrase. v. 过分；做得太过分；全力以赴
words.ex: He went overboard with the decorations for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他为派对装饰得太过分了。
words.en: To do something to an excessive or extreme degree, often beyond what is considered reasonable or necessary.

words.tr: phrase. 提出支持…的理由；为…辩护；论证…的必要性
words.ex: He made the case for better schools.
words.ex_cn: 他论证了需要更好的学校。
words.en: To argue in support of something; to present reasons for a particular course of action or belief.

words.tr: phrase. 论证…；提出充分理由说明…；阐明…的合理性
words.ex: He tried to make the case that we should plant more trees.
words.ex_cn: 他试图论证我们应该种更多的树。
words.en: To argue or present reasons in support of a particular point or position.

words.tr: phrase. 通常；大体上；一般而言
words.ex: In general, he likes to eat fruit.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，他喜欢吃水果。
words.en: Usually; in most cases.

words.tr: phrase. 选择；追求；努力争取
words.ex: I want to go for the blue shirt.
words.ex_cn: 我对那件蓝色的衬衫感兴趣。
words.en: If you go for something, you choose it or try to achieve it.

words.ex: The applicant filled out the form carefully.
words.ex_cn: 这位申请人仔细填写了表格。
words.en: An applicant is someone who applies for something, especially a job.

words.ex: Can you differentiate between the two colors?
words.ex_cn: 你能区分这两种颜色吗？
words.en: To differentiate means to recognize or express the difference between things or people.

words.ex: He took a snapshot of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他拍了一张日落的照片。
words.en: A snapshot is a photograph that is taken quickly and casually, or a brief summary or overview of something.

words.tr:
adj. 动态的；有活力的；不断变化的；
n. 活力；动力；
words.ex: The game has dynamic weather that changes every hour.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏有每小时变化的动态天气。
words.en: If you describe someone as dynamic, you approve of them because they are full of energy or full of new ideas.

words.ex: He is an introverted boy who likes reading alone.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢独自读书的内向男孩。
words.en: An introverted person is someone who tends to be more focused on their own thoughts and feelings rather than on external things or other people.

words.ex: He is a sociable man who likes to talk with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢和朋友聊天的外向的人。
words.en: A sociable person is friendly and enjoys being with other people.

words.ex: Watching movies is a popular entertainment.
words.ex_cn: 看电影是一种流行的休闲娱乐。
words.en: Entertainment refers to performances or activities that are intended to amuse or interest an audience.

words.tr: adj. 外向的；即将离职的；往外去的；
words.ex: He is an outgoing boy who loves talking to new people.
words.ex_cn: 他是个外向的男孩，喜欢和新朋友聊天。
words.en: Someone who is outgoing is very friendly and likes meeting and talking to people.

words.tr: adj. 有活力的；精力旺盛的；
words.ex: The energetic boy ran around the park all afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这个有活力的男孩整个下午都在公园里跑来跑去。
words.en: Someone who is energetic is very active and does not tire easily.

words.tr: adj. 无关紧要的；不相关的；
words.ex: His opinion is irrelevant to the decision.
words.ex_cn: 他的意见与这个决定无关紧要。
words.en: If you describe something as irrelevant, you mean that it is not important to or not connected with the present situation or discussion.

words.ex: The movie is controversial because it shows violence.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影因为展示暴力而有争议。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as controversial, you mean that they are the subject of intense public argument, disagreement, or disapproval.

words.tr: 短语动词. 超过可接受行为的界限；做得过分
words.ex: He crossed the line when he shouted at his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 当他朝老师大喊时，他越界了。
words.en: To go beyond what is considered acceptable behavior or limits.

words.tr: phrase. 为……打开大门；为……提供机会；使……成为可能
words.ex: Learning English opens the door to new opportunities.
words.ex_cn: 学习英语打开了通往新机会的大门。
words.en: If an action or event opens the door to something, it creates the possibility for that thing to happen or for someone to achieve something.

words.ex: He has prejudice against people from other countries.
words.ex_cn: 他对来自其他国家的人有偏见。
words.en: Prejudice is an unreasonable dislike of a particular group of people or things, or a preference for one group of people or things over another.

words.ex: He noticed the discrimination between the two prices.
words.ex_cn: 他注意到了两个价格之间的区别。
words.en: The unjust or prejudicial treatment of different categories of people, especially on the grounds of race, age, or sex.

words.ex: He was conscious after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后他醒了过来。
words.en: If you are conscious of something, you notice it or are aware of it.

words.ex: The teacher showed a bias for students who arrived early.
words.ex_cn: 老师对早到的学生有偏爱。
words.en: If someone is biased, they prefer one group of people to another, and behave unfairly as a result.

words.tr: phrase. 开始起作用；开始运转
words.ex: When we solve the problem, teamwork comes into play.
words.ex_cn: 当我们解决问题时，团队合作就发挥作用了。
words.en: To become active or have an effect; to start to operate or be used.

words.ex: He wants to apply for a job at the library.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请图书馆的工作。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.ex: He went outside regardless of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 他不顾下雨就出去了。
words.en: If you say that someone does something regardless, you mean that they do it without taking account of the possible problems or difficulties.

words.tr: phrase. 转移对……的注意力；使分心，使偏离
words.ex: Don't let noise distract from your homework.
words.ex_cn: 不要让噪音分散你做作业的注意力。
words.en: To distract someone from something means to take their attention away from it.

words.ex: The adverse weather delayed the flight.
words.ex_cn: 不利的天气延误了航班。
words.en: If something is adverse, it is harmful or unfavorable.

words.ex: The inner room is quiet and dark.
words.ex_cn: 内部的房间安静而昏暗。
words.en: Located inside or further in; relating to the mind or spirit.

words.tr: phrase. 打破纪录；创造新纪录
words.ex: She managed to beat a record in the 100-meter dash.
words.ex_cn: 她在100米短跑中成功破纪录。
words.en: To surpass a previously established record or achievement.

words.tr: adj. 值得拥有的；令人渴望的；称心如意的；
words.ex: A quiet neighborhood is desirable for families.
words.ex_cn: 安静的社区对家庭来说是值得拥有的。
words.en: Something that is desirable is worth having or doing because it is useful, necessary, or popular.

words.ex: Honesty is a good trait.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一种好的特性。
words.en: A trait is a particular characteristic, quality, or tendency that someone or something has.

words.ex: Exercise can reinforce your muscles.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以增强你的肌肉。
words.en: To reinforce something means to make it stronger or more effective.

words.tr:
v. 回火；适得其反
n. 逆火
words.ex: The engine backfired when he pressed the gas pedal.
words.ex_cn: 当他踩下油门时，发动机回火了。
words.en: If a plan or project backfires, it has the opposite result to the one that was intended.

words.tr:
v. 流利地讲话；熟背般地讲
n. 叫卖词；推销套话
words.ex: He gave a long spiel to convince us.
words.ex_cn: 他长篇大论地说服我们。
words.en: A spiel is a lengthy and often elaborate speech or story, typically one that is intended to persuade or entertain.

words.ex: His aspiration is to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他的渴望是成为一名医生。
words.en: A strong desire to achieve something high or great.

words.tr: phrase. 求职信；附函（随简历或文件一同寄出的说明信）
words.ex: He wrote a cover letter for his job application.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的工作申请写了一封求职信。
words.en: A cover letter is a document sent with your resume to provide additional information on your skills and experience. The letter typically provides detailed information on why you are qualified for the job you are applying for.

words.tr:
n. 轮廓；纲要；
v. 描画轮廓；概述；
words.ex: The artist drew the outline of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家画出了山的轮廓。
words.en: An outline is a line that shows or forms the outer edge of something, or a general description or plan showing the essential features of something but not the detail.

words.ex: The instructions were straightforward and easy to follow.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明很简单，容易遵循。
words.en: If you describe something as straightforward, you approve of it because it is easy to do or understand.

words.tr: phrase. 切题；切中要害；中肯；扼要
words.ex: His answer was to the point.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答切中要点。
words.en: If you describe something that someone says or writes as to the point, you approve of it because it is relevant to the subject and does not contain anything unnecessary.

words.tr: adj. 圆圈的；环形的；循环的；
words.ex: The table has a circular top.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子有一个圆形的桌面。
words.en: Something that is circular is shaped like a circle.

words.ex: Exercise can strengthen your muscles.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以增强你的肌肉。
words.en: To strengthen something means to make it stronger or more effective.

words.ex: The lecturer explains math clearly.
words.ex_cn: 这位授课老师讲解数学很清晰。
words.en: A lecturer is a person who gives lectures, especially as a profession.

words.tr: n. 伙伴关系；合作；合作关系；
words.ex: They formed a partnership to run a small shop.
words.ex_cn: 他们建立了一种伙伴关系来经营一家小店。
words.en: A partnership is a legal form of business operation between two or more individuals who share management and profits.

words.tr: phrase. v. 旨在；针对；以…为目标
words.ex: This program aims at helping poor children.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目旨在帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: If you aim at something, you direct your efforts or actions towards achieving it.

words.ex: The teacher puts emphasis on reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调每天阅读。
words.en: To give special importance or prominence to something in speaking or writing.

words.ex: He engages in sports after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后参加体育运动。
words.en: To participate or become involved in an activity.

words.ex: He made a proposal to improve the school lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了一个改善学校午餐的提案。
words.en: A proposal is a plan or suggestion, especially a formal one that is put forward for people to think about and decide upon.

words.tr:
n. 连接物；
v. 连接；联系；
words.ex: The chain has a broken link.
words.ex_cn: 这条链子有一个断了的连接物。
words.en: A link between two people, organizations, or places is a connection between them.

words.ex: He did voluntary work at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院做志愿工作。
words.en: If something is voluntary, you do it because you choose to, and not because you have to.

words.ex: He reads books in his leisure.
words.ex_cn: 他在空闲时间读书。
words.en: Leisure is the time when you are not working and you can relax and do things that you enjoy.

words.ex: He tends to arrive late for class.
words.ex_cn: 他总是迟到上课。
words.en: If someone or something tends to do a particular thing, they usually do it or they often do it.

words.tr: 短语动词. 开始认真做正事；着手处理重要事务
words.ex: We need to get down to business if we want to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: v. 我们需要开始认真工作，如果我们想按时完成项目。
words.en: To start doing what needs to be done, especially in a serious or determined way.

words.tr:
adj. 面对面的
adv. 面对面地
words.ex: We talk face-to-face every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们每个星期天都面对面交谈。
words.en: Involving direct contact or confrontation between individuals.

words.tr: n. 财务会计；金融会计
words.ex: He has a degree in finance-accounting and is now working as a financial analyst.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有财务会计学位，现在担任财务分析师。
words.en: The field of managing money, investments, and financial records for an organization.

words.tr:
n. 决策人；行政官；管理人员；
adj. 行政的；决策的；
words.ex: The executive decided to launch the new product.
words.ex_cn: 这位决策人决定推出新产品。
words.en: An executive is a person who has a senior management position in a business or other organization.

words.ex: He gave a verbal warning instead of a written one.
words.ex_cn: 他给了一个口头警告，而不是书面的。
words.en: Relating to or in the form of words.

words.ex: The course covers a wide breadth of topics.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程涵盖了广泛的主题。
words.en: The distance or measurement from side to side of something; width.

words.ex: His disposition is calm and kind.
words.ex_cn: 他的性情平静而善良。
words.en: Someone's disposition is the way that they tend to behave or feel.

words.tr:
n. 更新；
v. 更新；升级；
words.ex: The app sent me a new update.
words.ex_cn: 应用程序给我发送了一个新更新。
words.en: To make something more modern or up to date, especially by adding new information or changing its design or style.

words.ex: The government made a new regulation to control pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府出台了一项新管理措施来控制污染。
words.en: A regulation is an official rule or order.

words.ex: The teacher is very approachable and always smiles.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师非常和蔼可亲，总是面带微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone as approachable, you think that they are friendly and easy to talk to.

words.ex: He is confident when he speaks in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在全班面前说话时很自信。
words.en: If you are confident, you are certain of your abilities or of your beliefs.

words.ex: She is empathetic toward her friend's sadness.
words.ex_cn: 她对朋友的悲伤富有同理心。
